_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'DEFECT AND BUG TRACKING LOG' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-06.15.

f01_Defect_Identifier_and_Title.label: Defect Identifier and Title
f01_Defect_Identifier_and_Title.guidance: Unique defect ID, summary title, and affected component or module name.

f02_Severity_Priority_and_Business_Impac.label: Severity Priority and Business Impact
f02_Severity_Priority_and_Business_Impac.guidance: Severity rating (Blocker, Critical, Major, Minor) and SLA turnaround requirement.

f03_Steps_to_Reproduce_and_Observed_vers.label: Steps to Reproduce and Observed versus Expected
f03_Steps_to_Reproduce_and_Observed_vers.guidance: Detailed reproduction instructions, environment context, and expected versus actual result.

f04_Root_Cause_Diagnosis_and_Assigned_Fi.label: Root Cause Diagnosis and Assigned Fixer
f04_Root_Cause_Diagnosis_and_Assigned_Fi.guidance: Technical root cause classification (Code, Requirement, Environment) and assigned developer.

f05_Resolution_Status_and_QA_Retest_Sign.label: Resolution Status and QA Retest Signoff
f05_Resolution_Status_and_QA_Retest_Sign.guidance: Status (Open, In Fix, Retest, Verified Closed) and QA engineer verification signoff.
